themes.title: Far-right parties exploit migration crises for political gain
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are leveraging the ongoing migration crisis in Ceuta and other border regions to push for stricter immigration policies and criticize mainstream governments. This theme is evident in Spain, Italy, and France, where parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, and Rassemblement National are framing migration as a national security threat and demanding immediate action.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing governments in Argentina, the U.S., and Hungary are pushing for fiscal austerity, often targeting social programs and public spending. This theme reflects a broader trend of reducing state intervention in the economy, cutting welfare benefits, and privatizing public services, sparking debates over economic priorities and social equity.
